title: KeyProvider with macOS Keychain and `ward setup`
description: Spec §6.4 and §6.1. Evaluate @napi-rs/keyring (backend, pinned version, compiled-binary compatibility) before adopting. Explicit setup creates key and vault; nothing else ever regenerates a key. Bounded failure for locked/unavailable keychain.

acceptanceCriteria.text: T01: setup creates a native keystore item and encrypted state; --help, status and instructions never initialize a store
T02: existing vault with missing, locked or unavailable key fails closed and leaves the vault unchanged
The keyring binding decision (adopt or reject, with reasons) is recorded in the key-custody ADR
